claim: Landlock cannot be assumed available merely from a modern Linux kernel/version surface; the current Linux execution environment returned ENOSYS for the Landlock ABI query.
falsifier: Exact Frank v0.1 Ubuntu developer environment and all supported deployment modes prove Landlock availability and required feature coverage with no fallback need.
action: Runtime-probe sandbox backends; keep layered fallback. Do not weaken capability semantics.

claim: A semantic CapabilityToken record without OS/runtime enforcement does not remove ambient Linux authority.
falsifier: A runtime can demonstrate that metadata-only capabilities prevent all non-granted resource access without relying on an enforcement boundary.
action: Keep model output and capability metadata non-authoritative; lower grants through host-enforced handles/sandbox boundaries.
